I am a theoretical physicist specializing in theoretical cosmology, the physics of the early universe, inflation, and particle production. I am currently interested in exploring the early universe using QFT techniques. This includes, among other things, particle production by gravitational effects, the emission of Primordial Gravitational Waves (PGW), Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) formation, multi-field inflationary models, generation of large non-Gaussianities, dark matter production in the early universe, CMB physics and the exploration of the reheating stage.  I am also into Neutron Stars, Many-Body physics and Statistical Mechanics.
